scientific_limitations_integrity: Applies to normalized nonnegative Monge cost matrices with both dimensions at least two. Uses published full-dimensional vertex and facet characterization. No classification or uniqueness of all optimal centers; no extension to inverse-Monge. Exact rational finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof. Independent publication-priority auditing not performed.
title: Exact Minkowski asymmetry of every rectangular Monge polytope
